blocks.text: Royal Heights homes listed and sold, June to October 2026
Royal Heights, October 2026. Detached houses: 19 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 2 listed at month end and 0 sold in October.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 9 sold over 5 months against an average of 19.4 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 1 sold over 5 months against an average of 1.6 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 1 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Royal Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 19 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 2 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Royal Heights. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Royal Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
